items.title: Not One Analyst Rates Broadcom a Sell. What Are They Missing?
items.summary: Wall Street analysts are unanimous on Broadcom, yet the loudest skeptics sit on CNBC, and the stock has dropped after beating earnings before. Financing risks, supply limits, and a split in institutional money complicate the bullish picture.

items.title: Marvell Technology (MRVL) Dropped, What Is Behind The Latest Attention?
items.summary: Marvell Technology (MRVL) has been in the spotlight after agreeing to acquire optical networking specialist Lumentum in an all stock deal valued near US$115b, tying the chip designer more tightly to long term AI data center spending. The share price reaction has been choppy. Marvell Technology’s stock is down about 39% over the past month and 26% over 90 days, after a sharp reassessment of the Lumentum deal and sectorwide AI concerns. Even so, it still shows an 84% year to date share price...
